trigger_phrases.phrase: Purchase is in the legal process — awaiting solicitors, exchange, or final completion
Property not yet purchased — buying specifically with STL in mind
Off-plan property still awaiting build completion
Target property not yet identified or purchased
Funding/financing not yet arranged for the purchase
Property not yet under offer — still negotiating purchase price

typical_timeline.notes: Purchase-completion timelines ranged from one to two weeks (near-exchange deals) to roughly three months (off-plan builds or unidentified target properties); most leads expected completion within one to three months of the call.

what_leads_focus_on_while_waiting.concern: Whether the deal will actually complete at all (vendor, chain, or auction uncertainty)
Getting mortgage/funding structure and deposit sorted before completion
Solicitors/exchange progress and an exact completion date
Whether Stayful can support the purchase itself (e.g. an income-projection letter for a mortgage broker)
Off-plan build completion date and how that affects the first year's ramp-up income

how_to_handle_in_meeting.acknowledge_phrase: Yeah. When do you think it'd be a good time to get back in touch?
how_to_handle_in_meeting.timeline_question: Where are you in the process right now — has anything exchanged, and what's the realistic completion date your solicitor or the vendor has given you?
how_to_handle_in_meeting.reframe_approach: Present the income figures as the reason to keep moving on the purchase (funding, solicitors) rather than as something to revisit only once it completes — offer concrete purchase-adjacent help, like an income-projection letter for a mortgage broker, so Stayful stays useful during the wait.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.how_to_keep_engaged: Set a specific follow-up date tied to their stated completion milestone (exchange, keys handover, mortgage decision) rather than a generic check-in, and offer to send supporting documents they can use with solicitors or brokers in the meantime.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.what_to_write_to_monday: Log the purchase stage (offer/exchange/completion), the expected completion date, and any document requested for the purchase process (e.g. income letter), so follow-up timing is driven by the deal, not a fixed calendar cadence.

do_not_attempt_offer_because: The lead does not yet own the property, so Stayful has nothing to manage and no legal basis to sign an agreement — a time-limited discount would expire before the purchase (which is outside Stayful's or the lead's control) can even complete.
